# Kachi Batteries

> Online store for genuine car and inverter batteries (Amaron, Exide, Power Zone, Elito) in India, run from Bengaluru by Kachi Batteries, a sister concern of Manjunatha Batteries. Customers can find a battery by car make and model, size an inverter battery with a backup calculator, pay online or cash on delivery, and get free standard delivery.

## Key facts

- Products: car batteries, inverter batteries (tubular, SMF/VRLA, lithium), inverters and UPS.
- Brands: Amaron, Exide, Power Zone, Elito.
- Prices on the site exclude GST; GST is added per product in the cart and at checkout.
- Old battery exchange: choose the exchange price and hand over the old battery at delivery or installation.
- Delivery: standard delivery free (3–5 business days); express ₹299 (1–2 business days); doorstep installation with old battery pickup ₹499.
- Payment: online (UPI, cards, net banking via Cashfree) or cash on delivery.
- Returns: unused, uninstalled batteries within 7 days of delivery; transit damage reported within 48 hours.
- Warranty: manufacturer warranty as shown on each product page; claims via the brand's authorised service centres.
- Jump start service: Bengaluru only, during store hours, usually 30–60 minutes; price on call.
- Store: Manjunatha Batteries, Bengaluru, Karnataka. Phone/WhatsApp +91 81975 68707, email kachibatteries@gmail.com.

## Guides

- [Car Battery Maintenance: 9 Tips to Make It Last Longer](https://www.kachibatteries.com/blog/car-battery-maintenance-tips): Drive regularly, keep terminals clean and tight, park in the shade and test after 3 years. Nine habits that make a car battery last longer.
- [What Size Inverter Battery Do I Need? Ah and VA Explained](https://www.kachibatteries.com/blog/inverter-battery-capacity-guide): Watts × backup hours ÷ 9 gives the Ah for a 12V battery. Worked examples, inverter VA sizing and when you need two batteries.
- [How Long Does a Car Battery Last in India? 7 Signs It Needs Replacing](https://www.kachibatteries.com/blog/how-long-does-a-car-battery-last): Most car batteries in India last about 3 to 5 years. Learn the 7 warning signs it needs replacing and how to make yours last longer.
- [How to Choose the Right Car Battery in India (2026 Guide)](https://www.kachibatteries.com/blog/how-to-choose-car-battery): Match your car's battery size, terminal layout, Ah and CCA, then pick a trusted brand with a long free-replacement warranty. A step-by-step guide.
- [Tubular vs SMF Inverter Batteries: Which Is Right for Your Home?](https://www.kachibatteries.com/blog/tubular-vs-smf): Tubular lasts longest and suits frequent power cuts; SMF is sealed and maintenance-free for lighter backup. Compare both, plus lithium.
- [How to Jump Start a Car Safely: Step-by-Step Guide](https://www.kachibatteries.com/blog/jump-start-guide): Red to dead +, red to donor +, black to donor −, last clamp to bare metal. Safe step-by-step jump start, mistakes to avoid and what to do after.
